items.source: Return the ApplicationContext associated with the web application, if it was initialized with one via WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext).

items.source: Return the LocaleContext using the configured LocaleContextResolver.

items.source: Return a builder to mutate properties of this exchange by wrapping it with ServerWebExchangeDecorator and returning either mutated values or delegating back to this instance.
items.translation: 返回一个构建器，通过用ServerWebExchangeDecorator包装此 exchange 来修改其属性，并返回突变后的值或委托回该实例。

items.source: Use of this method does not automatically create a session. See WebSession for more details.
items.translation: 使用此方法不会自动创建会话。有关详细信息，请参阅 WebSession。

items.source: Note: calling this method causes the request body to be read and parsed in full and the resulting MultiValueMap is cached so that this method is safe to call more than once.
items.translation: 注意： 调用此方法会导致请求体被完整读取和解析，生成的 MultiValueMap 会被缓存，因此可以安全地多次调用此方法。

items.source: Note:the contents of each part is not cached, and can only be read once.
items.translation: 注意：每个部分的内容不会被缓存，且只能读取一次。

items.source: Note that the given function is applied after any previously registered functions.
items.translation: 注意，给定的函数将在任何先前注册的函数之后应用。

items.source: Name of attribute whose value can be used to correlate log messages for this exchange. Use getLogPrefix() to obtain a consistently formatted prefix based on this attribute.
items.translation: 名称为 `attribute` 的属性，其值可用于关联此交换的日志消息。使用 `getLogPrefix()` 获取基于该属性的一致格式前缀。

items.source: Transform the given url according to the registered transformation function(s). By default, this method returns the given url, though additional transformation functions can be registered with addUrlTransformer(Function)
items.translation: 根据注册的转换函数对给定的 url 进行转换。默认情况下，此方法返回给定的url，但可以通过addUrlTransformer(Function)注册额外的转换函数。

items.source: Name of attribute whose value can be used to correlate log messages for this exchange.
items.translation: 名称为 `attribute` 的属性，其值可用于关联此交换的日志消息。

items.source: Register an additional URL transformation function for use with transformUrl(String).
items.translation: 为与transformUrl(String)一起使用，注册一个额外的 URL 转换函数。

items.source: Return the request attribute value or if not present raise an IllegalArgumentException.
items.translation: 返回请求属性值，如果不存在则抛出IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: Returns true if the one of the checkNotModified methods in this contract were used and they returned true.
items.translation: 如果此合约中的任一 `checkNotModified` 方法被调用且返回了 `true`，则返回 `true`。

items.source: Return a log message prefix to use to correlate messages for this exchange. The prefix is based on the value of the attribute LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE along with some extra formatting so that the prefix can be conveniently prepended with no further formatting no separators required.
items.translation: 返回一个日志消息前缀，用于关联此交换的消息。该前缀基于属性 LOG_ID_ATTRIBUTE 的值，并包含一些额外的格式化内容，以便可以方便地直接添加该前缀，无需进一步格式化或分隔符。

items.source:
Contract for an HTTP request-response interaction. Provides access to the HTTP
request and response and also exposes additional server-side processing
related properties and features such as request attributes.
items.translation: HTTP 请求 - 响应交互的合约。提供对 HTTP 请求和响应的访问，并公开与服务器端处理相关的其他属性和功能，例如请求属性。

items.source: Cleans up any storage used for multipart handling.
items.translation: 清理用于多部分处理的任何存储。

items.translation: 如果存在，则返回请求属性值。

items.source: Return the request attribute value, or a default, fallback value.
items.translation: 返回请求属性值，或默认/备用值。

items.source: Return a mutable map of request attributes for the current exchange.
items.translation: 返回当前交换的可变请求属性映射。

items.source: Return the authenticated user for the request, if any.
items.translation: 如有，返回请求的已认证用户。

items.source: Return the current HTTP request.
items.translation: 返回当前的 HTTP 请求。

items.source: Return the current HTTP response.
items.translation: 返回当前的 HTTP 响应。

items.source:
Always guaranteed to return either an instance matching the session id
requested by the client, or a new session either because the client did not
specify a session id or because the underlying session expired.
items.translation: 始终保证返回与客户端请求的会话 ID 匹配的实例，或一个新的会话（因为客户端未指定会话 ID 或底层会话已过期）。

items.translation: 用于修改现有ServerWebExchange的构建器。

items.source: Check whether the requested resource has been modified given the supplied ETag (entity tag) and last-modified timestamp as determined by the application.
items.translation: 检查请求的资源是否已修改，依据是提供的`ETag`（实体标签）以及由应用程序确定的最后修改时间戳。

items.source: Return the form data from the body of the request if the Content-Type is "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" or an empty map otherwise.
items.translation: 如果 Content-Type 为 `"application/x-www-form-urlencoded"`，则返回请求主体的表单数据；否则返回一个空映射。

items.source: Return the parts of a multipart request if the Content-Type is "multipart/form-data" or an empty map otherwise.
items.translation: 如果 Content-Type 为 `"multipart/form-data"`，则返回多部分请求的各个部分；否则返回一个空映射。
